_why: Cited commits that no rewrite map can take to a clone-visible commit, each with the reason it cannot be one. NONE of these is unrecovered rewrite damage -- that distinction is the whole point of writing them down. Every entry needs a stated reason: a bare SHA on an allow-list is indistinguishable from a defect somebody got tired of, and check_rewrite_maps.py treats a reasonless entry as its own finding. Delete an entry when its cause is fixed (push the branch, land the rescue) rather than growing this file.
